g.title: TF_DATA_LOADER_TEMPLATES
g.text: Data Loader Templates - Data Loader Templates

This option makes sense when you also choose the option to download data in the file and the data source attached to the template is hierarchical. By activating this option, data will be downloaded flat. Otherwise downloaded data will reflect the hierarchy between entities.

With this option activated, all entities/codes referenced in columns as “Lookup” will be resolved and put in cache as the rows get loaded. If you deactivate this option, instead, you would get better data load response times and all referenced codes/entities will be resolved and cached at the beginning of the data load.
Tick this flag to resolve lookup code reference with case unsensitive
With this option activated, data will be saved row by row. Deactivating this option, all contiguous records in the file pertaining the same root entity will be saved in the same transaction.
Tick this flag to view the template in the search pages.
Tick this flag to ignore the template filter during the export by the search pages.
Tick this flag to prevent application rules execution during the smart data loader execution.

The Two Factor Authentication Activation date
The start date used to calculate the deadline for each user to complete the 2FA setup.
Indicates the date of last time the user logon the system by the two factor authentication.
With this option activated, the user can no longer be activated . All tasks / logs / activities this user was linked to will continue to be logged like that

g.title: TF_PROFILE_CATALOG
g.text: When turned off, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can impersonate any active user. When turned on, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can only impersonate active users included in the specified set
A set used to limit the list of users that is possible to impersonate using the proxy logon feature.
This profile is exclude from automatical assignment of default profiles.
